remarks:
Get ready to fall in love with this sleek, stylish, and thoughtfully crafted barndominium! Set on approximately three peaceful acres on a quiet, lesser-traveled road, this incredible home offers endless views of the rolling countryside. Though tucked away in a serene setting, the interior boasts an ultra-modern, urban vibe. Built just three years ago, this spectacular home perfectly executes an "industrial chic" aesthetic. It effortlessly blends cool concrete and metals with warm woods and a soothing color palette to create a space that is bright, airy, and incredibly inviting.

The heart of the home is a spectacular great room featuring soaring ceilings dressed in beautiful tongue-and-groove knotty pine. This open space flows seamlessly into the dining area and a fabulous, fully equipped kitchen that is ready for the home chef, showcasing gleaming granite countertops, a center breakfast island, and loads of custom cabinet space. The true piece de resistance is an incredible integrated overhead door in the living area that opens to reveal the scenic outdoors. It is fully screened, allowing you to enjoy the fresh country breeze while keeping nature outside!

When it is time to relax, two well-appointed bedrooms provide ample closet space, beautifully supplemented by a versatile loft area for additional sleeping arrangements or flex space. The full bathroom is a brilliant, one-of-a-kind creation featuring a stunning tin-lined shower with a tile bench and floor that is guaranteed to be a conversation starter. Comfort is guaranteed year-round with an efficient unit heater and a mini-split for cooling, while a freestanding electric fireplace adds the perfect touch of warmth and ambiance on extra chilly nights.

Car enthusiasts and hobbyists will absolutely adore the oversized, attached garage. This dream space is fully heated and features water access, 220v capability, and plenty of dedicated shop room. Everything in this magnificent property was thoughtfully designed and completed with the utmost care and pride, offering you the rare opportunity to simply move right in, kick back, and enjoy!

Can be purchased fully furnished! Brand new septic!
